title: Understanding AL Development: The Type Helper Code Unit
summary: The Type Helper code unit is a utility in Business Central's System.Reflection namespace containing 74 procedures for data formatting, localization, type conversion, and math functions commonly used in API handling and advanced AL development scenarios.
key_points: Type Helper is a modular helper code unit that encapsulates reusable logic for common tasks like formatting, validation, and calculations
It contains 74 active procedures organized into categories covering dates, times, options, encoding, formatting, and bitwise operations
Procedures include Evaluate for type conversion, various FormatDate/FormatDateTime methods for localization, and encoding functions like UrlEncode, HtmlEncode, and JavaScriptStringEncode
The code unit provides timezone handling, UTC datetime operations, currency formatting, and utility functions like TextDistance and SortRecordRef
AL code compiles to .NET, and Type Helper mirrors .NET Reflection functionality while being tailored for Business Central's needs
